'''TX-8080''' was a [[human]] [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] of the [[First Order]], originally [[Reproduction|born]] on [[Hevurion]]. A [[First Order snowtrooper|snowtrooper]] [[commander]], TX-8080 served as part of the [[Kijimi garrison|garrison]] on [[Kijimi]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
